votes.reasoning: Both peakDayText branches (AnalyticsFormatters.swift:46/48) and the card label (VendorAnalyticsCardView.swift:105) now go through quotaText (AnalyticsFormatters.swift:54-56). quotaText passes PercentText.whole (a Swift Int) to 'analytics_quota_percent_fmt'. The key is '%ld%%' in all three languages (en:319, pt-BR:318, es:318), and %ld is the right specifier for a 64-bit Int passed as CVarArg. The 5 tests pass. Reversal was line-level, because the test calls quotaText and a whole-file restore would not compile: I made quotaText return the old literal Int(saturating:)+'% quota'. All 5 tests went RED (for example pt-BR '(84% quota)' vs '(85% da quota)'), and the file was then restored byte-identical (cmp). Side effect: 84.6 now shows as 85 instead of 84, because it follows the CQ-MAE-018 rounding rule. This is intended.

The literal '% quota' was repeated in 3 places (AnalyticsFormatters.swift:46 and :48, and VendorAnalyticsCardView.swift:105). The fix replaces all of them with one helper, AnalyticsFormatters.quotaText (:54), which uses the key analytics_quota_percent_fmt. That key is added to en, pt-BR and es in the same diff, so the three .lproj files stay in step, as the repo's docs rule requires. quotaText uses PercentText.whole, so the rounding matches the rest of the UI. The helper is 1 line with a doc comment that says why it exists. %ld with Int is fine on arm64 and x86_64. The new tests are one fact per #expect and are non-Bool (hasSuffix on a String), so they are not the vacuous forms the repo bans.

The three locale files are in lockstep. analytics_quota_percent_fmt is "%ld%% quota" in en.lproj:319, "%ld%% da quota" in pt-BR.lproj:318 and "%ld%% de la cuota" in es.lproj:318. All three use the same specifiers (one %ld plus an escaped %%), and the argument is PercentText.whole, which returns Int, so %ld matches on 64-bit. Both hard-coded ' quota' sites now go through AnalyticsFormatters.quotaText (AnalyticsFormatters.swift:46/48/55 and VendorAnalyticsCardView.swift:105), and grep finds no '% quota' literal left in Sources/AiTaskbarApp. quotaText is public, but it is inside the app target, so no library contract changes. The new test file AnalyticsQuotaLocalizationTests.swift belongs to this id.
